verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The marketing line about 'One Agent across connected workflows' describes an in-product assistant, and the Events API OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block; neither is an MCP endpoint an external agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
